# Specification Mapper
URL: https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/
Language: zh-TW
Summary: Specification Mapper 是一套協助建構 Spring Data JPA Specifications 的工具，提供注解式、可擴充且可讀性高的查詢條件組合能力。

## Documentation Index

- Mapper — https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/zh/docs/mapper/
Summary: Core Domain

- SpecMapper — https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/zh/docs/mapper/spec/
Summary: 操作入口


- Simple Specs — https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/zh/docs/mapper/simple/
Summary: 基本查詢條件


- Combine Specs — https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/zh/docs/mapper/combine/
Summary: 組合多個查詢條件


- Nested Specs — https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/zh/docs/mapper/nested/
Summary: 處理巢狀物件的查詢條件


- Join — https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/zh/docs/mapper/join/
Summary: 關聯查詢的過濾條件


- Join Fetch — https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/zh/docs/mapper/fetch/
Summary: 關聯查詢的過濾條件, 並同時選取指定欄位


- Customize Specs — https://softleader.github.io/specification-mapper/zh/docs/mapper/customize/
Summary: 客製化與擴充查詢條件
